chapters.title: The square
chapters.stand: Salah al-Din Square, on the Citadel side, facing the domed tomb end of the mosque across the road.

moments.cue: Hold it up to the mosque: then and now

chapters.title: The two minarets
chapters.stand: Salah al-Din Square, on the pavement facing the domed tomb end, looking up at the two minarets on either side of the dome.

moments.cue: Hold it up to the minarets: then and now

chapters.title: The long wall
chapters.stand: the lane between Sultan Hassan and Al-Rifa'i, close to the long north-east wall, walking toward the portal.

chapters.title: The portal
chapters.stand: Stand in the lane, a few steps back from the portal, and face the door. UNVERIFIED: mark to be checked on site (3D guide v13).

moments.cue: Raise your phone to the top of the portal
Hold it up to the portal: then and now

chapters.title: The entrance hall
chapters.stand: inside the door, in the domed entrance hall (vestibule), facing the back wall of marble.

moments.cue: Hold it up: then and now

chapters.title: The bent, dark passage
chapters.stand: from the back of the entrance hall, up the steps, into the passage that turns toward the courtyard.

chapters.title: The courtyard
chapters.stand: beside the fountain pavilion in the middle of the court, facing the great hall, the biggest arch, which faces Mecca. UNVERIFIED: mark to be checked on site (3D guide v13.3).

moments.cue: Hold it up to the courtyard: then and now

chapters.title: The side halls and the corner doors
chapters.stand: in the courtyard, north-east of the fountain pavilion, about seventeen metres from it, facing it, with the south-west hall beyond it. UNVERIFIED: mark to be checked on site (3D guide v12).

moments.cue: Hold it up to the court: then and now

chapters.title: A college courtyard
chapters.stand: inside the college (madrasa) door, in the small court, facing the student cells across it. UNVERIFIED: whether a college court is open to visitors today; if not, this chapter plays at the corner doorway, looking through, and the 360 view does the walking. Mark to be checked on site (3D guide v12).

chapters.title: The great hall
chapters.stand: on the carpet at the north-east side of the great hall facing Mecca (the qibla iwan), the raised platform (dikka) ahead of you and the prayer niche to your left. UNVERIFIED: mark to be checked on site (3D guide v12).

moments.cue: Hold it up to the great hall: then and now

chapters.title: The tomb
chapters.stand: inside the tomb chamber, by the wooden screen around the cenotaph, facing the prayer-niche wall, under the dome. UNVERIFIED: mark to be checked on site (3D guide v12).

chapters.title: The working town
chapters.stand: outside, on the north-west side of the mosque, by the ruins and excavated remains, then back in the lane facing Al-Rifa'i. UNVERIFIED: whether the ruins are open or only seen over a fence; if only seen, the chapter plays from the lane and the 360 view does the walking.

rehearsal.note: Walking times are estimates, not measured. Check the opening hours on the day; on a Friday, start by 9:30 so the walk ends before the midday prayer (closing time unverified). Headphones on, phone down: the screen lights up only for what you cannot see.
